prompt:
A highly detailed, photorealistic close-up portrait of a young East Asian woman in her late teens to early twenties, with a soft, gentle, and slightly coy expression. She has fair, smooth, porcelain-like skin with a natural soft glow, subtle rosy cheeks, and a delicate, feminine facial structure. Large, expressive dark brown eyes with long natural lashes look softly toward the camera, accompanied by a gentle closed-mouth smile with soft pink lips. 

Her long, straight, silky dark brown hair falls past her shoulders with a natural slight wave at the ends, featuring neat straight bangs that evenly cover her forehead. The hair has a healthy shine and soft volume. She wears a simple, casual white long-sleeve shirt with a relaxed fit and clean fabric texture. 

Her right hand is raised near her face, with fingers lightly resting against her chin and cheek in a soft, feminine pose. Soft natural daylight illuminates her face evenly from the front-side, creating gentle shadows and a bright, airy atmosphere. The background is a clean, minimalist indoor setting with plain off-white walls and soft diffused light, slightly out of focus to keep full attention on her face and upper body.

Shot as a vertical portrait from the chest up, ultra-realistic skin texture, natural makeup (soft blush, light lip tint, subtle eye definition), high detail in hair strands and fabric, professional beauty photography style, shallow depth of field, 85mm lens look, soft bokeh, 8k quality, photorealistic.
